original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹人民国防军向瓦乌县部署部队开展解除武装行动
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹人民国防军（SSPDF）周二向西加扎勒河州瓦乌县部署重装部队，执行总统萨尔瓦·基尔数月前下令的解除武装行动。SSPDF第五步兵师副指挥官沃尔·德尔·泰普少将表示，行动期间将同步宣布为期六个月的紧急状态，覆盖西加扎勒河州、瓦拉布州、湖泊州和团结州。他警告称，拒绝交出非法枪支者将被严厉处置。此次行动据称旨在改善瓦乌安全局势并为和平选举铺路。

location.raw_text: Wau County in Western Bahr el Ghazal State

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹人民国防军周二向瓦乌县部署重装部队开展解除武装行动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The South Sudan People’s Defense Forces (SSPDF) on Tuesday dispatched heavily armed troops to Wau County in Western Bahr el Ghazal State to carry out a disarmament exercise

key_facts.fact: 行动系总统萨尔瓦·基尔数月前下令
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: as ordered by President Salva Kiir a few months ago

key_facts.fact: 行动期间将同步宣布为期六个月的紧急状态，覆盖四个州
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The six-month state of emergency is a presidential directive, and it will be implemented in the four states of Western Bahr el Ghazal, Warrap, Lakes and Unity

key_facts.fact: 军方警告拒绝交出非法枪支者将被严厉处置
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He warned that if they fail to surrender the guns, the SSPDF will deal with them without lenience.

key_facts.fact: 当局称行动旨在改善瓦乌安全并为和平选举铺路
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The disarmament operation is expected to improve security in Wau and pave the way for peaceful elections.

uncertainties: 目前仅单一来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
紧急状态的具体实施时间与范围尚未获独立确认
解除武装行动的实际效果与是否引发冲突尚待观察
